homepage.body:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
  <meta name="description" content="Put localhost on the Internet with a free, encrypted Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account, DNS, or open ports required.">
  <title>Cloudflare Quick Tunnels</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon" sizes="32x32">
  <style>
    @font-face { font-family: 'STK Bureau'; src: url('/fonts/stk-bureau-book.woff2') format('woff2'); font-weight: 300; font-display: swap; }
    @font-face { font-family: 'STK Bureau'; src: url('/fonts/stk-bureau-regular.woff2') format('woff2'); font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; }
    @font-face { font-family: 'Paper Mono'; src: url('/fonts/paper-mono.woff2') format('woff2'); font-weight: 100 800; font-display: swap; }

    :root {
      --orange-900: #f46021;
      --orange-600: #f69000;
      --orange-500: #ffb834;
      --orange-300: #ffd581;
      --orange-800: #fea700;
      --orange-100: #ffefd4;
      --text-base: #292929;
      --text-default: #707070;
      --text-muted: #8f8f8f;
      --text-faint: #d1d1d1;
      --border: #f4f4f4;
      --border-muted: #f5f5f5;
      --border-dashed: #ebebeb;
      --grid: #f4f4f4;
      --surface: #fdfdfd;
      --faint: #f7f7f7;
      --base: #fff;
      --success: #25855a;
      --blue: #1570c8;
      --purple: #7559b8;
      --sans: 'STK Bureau', Arial, sans-serif;
      --mono: 'Paper Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
      --page: 1200px;
      --ease-cf: cubic-bezier(.6,.6,0,1);
      --shadow-elevation: inset 0 0 0 1px transparent,0 24px 32px -12px oklab(0% 0 0/.03),0 6px 12px 0 oklab(0% 0 0/.01),0 3px 6px 0 oklab(0% 0 0/.01),0 0 0 1px oklab(0% 0 0/.04);
      --shadow-button-primary: inset 0 -1px 3px 0 oklab(84.5135% .0481 .0956/.12),inset 0 -.5px .5px 0 oklab(84.5135% .0481 .0956/.24),inset 0 -.25px .25px 0 oklab(74.7246% .0841 .1355/.4),inset 0 4px 8px 0 oklab(84.5135% .0481 .0956/.12),inset 0 1px 3px 0 oklab(84.5135% .0481 .0956/.24),inset 0 .5px .5px 0 oklab(84.5135% .0481 .0956/.32),inset 0 .25px .25px 0 #f69032,0 6px 10px -4px oklab(64.7844% .1534 .1154/.24),0 2px 4px -1px oklab(64.7844% .1534 .1154/.12),0 1px 1px -.5px oklab(64.7844% .1534 .1154/.12),0 .5px .5px 0 oklab(64.7844% .1534 .1154/.12);
    }

    @supports (color: color(display-p3 0 0 0)) {
      :root { --orange-900: color(display-p3 .9569 .3765 .1294); --orange-600: color(display-p3 .9882 .6118 0); --orange-500: color(display-p3 1 .7216 .2039); --orange-300: color(display-p3 1 .8353 .5059); }
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { overflow-x: hidden; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body { margin: 0; overflow-x: hidden; background: var(--base); color: var(--text-base); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.5; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { color: inherit; font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3, p { margin: 0; }
    .sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
    ::selection { background: var(--orange-900); color: #fff; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange-900); outline-offset: 3px; }

    main { position: relative; }
    main::before { position: absolute; z-index: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: min(var(--page),100%); border-inline: 1px dashed var(--border-dashed); content: ''; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none; }

    .page { position: relative; width: min(var(--page), 100%); margin-inline: auto; border-inline: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .page-label { position: absolute; top: 29px; width: max-content; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none; }
    .page-label.left { right: calc(100% + 40px); }
    .register-dot { position: absolute; z-index: 4; width: 2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange-900); }
    .register-dot.tl { top: 8px; left: 8px; }
    .register-dot.tr { top: 8px; right: 8px; }
    .section { position: relative; scroll-margin-top: 80px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .section-grid { background-color: var(--surface); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px); background-size: 80px 80px; }

    .dashed-wide::before, .dashed-wide::after { position: absolute; top: -1px; width: 100vw; height: 1px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-dashed) 0 3px,transparent 3px 8px); content: ''; }
    .dashed-wide::before { right: 100%; }
    .dashed-wide::after { left: 100%; }

    .button { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 20px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all .2s var(--ease-cf); }
    .button:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }
    .button-primary { background: var(--orange-900); color: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-primary); }
    .button-primary::before, .button-primary::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; content: ''; opacity: .24; transition: opacity .2s var(--ease-cf); }
    .button-primary::before { background: linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--orange-600),transparent 40%); background: linear-gradient(to bottom in oklab,var(--orange-600),transparent 40%); }
    .button-primary::after { background: linear-gradient(to top,var(--orange-600),transparent 40%); background: linear-gradient(to top in oklab,var(--orange-600),transparent 40%); }
    .button-primary:hover::before, .button-primary:hover::after { opacity: .32; }
    .button-primary:active::before, .button-primary:active::after { opacity: .08; }
    .button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-primary),0 0 0 2.5px var(--base),0 0 0 3.5px var(--orange-900); }
    .button-secondary { background: var(--base); box-shadow: 0 8px 12px -2px transparent, 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.05); }
    .button-secondary:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 12px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.03), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.03), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
    .button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px -2px #00000005,0 2px 4px -1px #00000005,0 1px 1px -.5px #00000005,0 0 0 1px #0000000a,0 0 0 2.5px var(--base),0 0 0 3.5px var(--orange-900); }
    .button span { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding-inline: 6px; }
    .button svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .header-spacer { height: 80px; }
    .header { position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto; z-index: 50; height: 80px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
    .header-inner { position: relative; width: min(var(--page),100%); height: 80px; margin-inline: auto; padding: 24px 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-inline: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .header::after { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 1px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--border-dashed) 0 3px,transparent 3px 8px); content: ''; }
    .brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 400; }
    .brand svg { width: 34px; color: var(--orange-900); }
    .brand-product { padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 14px; }
    .nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-left: 28px; }
    .nav a { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; }
    .nav a:hover { background: var(--faint); }
    .header-actions { margin-left: auto; }

    .hero { min-height: 600px; }
    .hero-copy { position: absolute; z-index: 3; bottom: 88px; left: 80px; width: 440px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0; }
    .hero-eyebrow { margin-bottom: 24px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .hero-eyebrow span { word-spacing: 4.75px; }
    .hero-eyebrow b { color: var(--orange-900); font-weight: inherit; }
    .hero h1 { max-width: 560px; font-size: 56px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 60px; text-wrap: balance; }
    .hero-copy > p { max-width: 500px; margin-top: 24px; color: var(--text-default); font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.25; text-wrap: pretty; }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 32px; }

    .tunnel-ui { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 80px; z-index: 2; width: 480px; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .sequence-block { position: relative; padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--base); animation: sequence-in .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; }
    .sequence-block + .sequence-block { margin-top: 12px; }
    .sequence-block:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .85s; }
    .sequence-block:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1.55s; }
    .sequence-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .sequence-head span:last-child { margin-left: auto; }
    .sequence-running { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange-900); animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out 2; }
    .command-pill { min-width: 0; padding: 6px 8px 6px 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--base); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 24px; }
    .command-pill .prompt { color: var(--text-muted); user-select: none; }
    .command-pill code { min-width: 0; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; color: #171717; font: inherit; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .command-pill .copy-icon { border: 0; border-radius: 50%; }
    .sequence-status { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
    .result-check { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #edf8f2; color: var(--success); font-size: 13px; }
    .sequence-status strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; }
    .sequence-status small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; }
    .sequence-url { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .sequence-url code { min-width: 0; flex: 1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--orange-900); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; line-height: 20px; }

    .benefits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); }
    .benefit { position: relative; min-height: 262px; padding: 40px; background: var(--base); }
    .benefit + .benefit { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .benefit svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--orange-900); }
    .benefit h3 { margin-top: 28px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; }
    .benefit p { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--text-default); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; text-wrap: balance; }

    .section-intro { min-height: 400px; padding: 80px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 560px 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: start; background: var(--base); }
    .kicker { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-inline: 6px; background: var(--orange-900); color: #fff; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .kicker::after, .kicker::before { position: absolute; left: calc(100% + 2px); width: 2px; height: 12px; top: 2px; background: var(--orange-500); content: ''; }
    .kicker::before { left: calc(100% + 6px); height: 8px; top: 4px; background: var(--orange-300); }
    .section-intro h2 { max-width: 560px; margin-top: 24px; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.08; text-wrap: balance; }
    .section-intro h2 .muted { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .section-intro h2 .accent { color: var(--orange-900); }
    .section-intro p { max-width: 500px; padding-top: 106px; color: var(--text-base); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.42; text-wrap: pretty; }

    .flow-stage { min-height: 640px; padding: 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background-color: var(--surface); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px); background-size: 80px 80px; }
    .architecture { position: relative; min-height: 560px; padding: 56px 48px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevation); }
    .architecture::before, .architecture::after { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--base); content: ''; }
    .architecture::before { top: -7px; left: -7px; }
    .architecture::after { right: -7px; bottom: -7px; }
    .architecture-labels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.15fr 1.4fr; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .architecture-labels span { justify-self: center; padding: 3px 8px; background: #f4f4f4; }
    .architecture-labels span:nth-child(2) { background: var(--orange-100); color: var(--orange-900); }
    .architecture-flow { margin-top: 44px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px,1fr) 64px minmax(150px,1.15fr) 64px minmax(230px,1.4fr); align-items: center; }
    .arch-node { position: relative; min-height: 112px; padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--base); }
    .arch-node small { color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .arch-node strong { margin-top: 9px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; }
    .arch-node span { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--text-default); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; }
    .arch-node.edge { border-color: var(--orange-300); background: #fffaf6; }
    .arch-node.edge small, .arch-node.edge strong { color: var(--orange-900); }
    .private-zone { padding: 20px; border: 1px dashed #ccc; background: rgba(253,253,252,.9); }
    .private-zone-label { margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .private-pair { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 24px 1fr; align-items: center; }
    .private-pair .arch-node { min-height: 86px; padding: 13px; }
    .local-link { height: 1px; background: var(--orange-900); }
    .arch-route { position: relative; height: 1px; overflow: visible; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange-900) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px); animation: march .75s linear infinite; }
    .arch-route::after { position: absolute; top: -3px; right: 0; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--orange-900); border-right: 1px solid var(--orange-900); content: ''; transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .architecture-meta { margin-top: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--base); }
    .architecture-meta div { padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--text-default); font-size: 11px; }
    .architecture-meta div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .architecture-meta i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); }

    .code-layout { min-height: 560px; padding: 40px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 40px; background-color: var(--surface); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grid) .5px,transparent .5px); background-size: 80px 80px; }
    .code-copy { padding: 40px 0; }
    .code-copy h2 { margin-top: 24px; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.025em; line-height: 1.08; }
    .code-copy > p { margin-top: 24px; color: var(--text-default); line-height: 1.3; }
    .code-copy > p code { padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--base); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; }
    .code-notes { margin-top: 30px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
    .code-notes span { padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--base); color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9px; }
    .code-card { align-self: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0; background: var(--base); box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevation); }
    .code-bar { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; }
    .code-bar > span:first-child { position: relative; align-self: stretch; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--orange-900); }
    .code-bar > span:first-child::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--orange-900); content: ''; }
    .code-bar > span:last-of-type { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; }
    .code-bar .copy-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-left: 8px; border-block: 0; border-right: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--orange-900); }
    .code-command { min-height: 80px; padding: 0 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 24px; }
    .code-command .prompt { color: var(--text-faint); }
    .code-command code { color: var(--orange-900); font: inherit; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .code-output { min-height: 152px; padding: 24px 28px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 24px; }
    .output-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--success); }
    .output-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #edf8f2; }
